scope: Real MainActivity Java methods and callbacks extracted unchanged, executed on JVM with deterministic test doubles; complete Android source separately compiled against API23. Not Android runtime or device validation.
limitations: No Android device or emulator was available.
The doubles do not implement Chromium, Android rendering/lifecycle scheduling, TLS or certificate trust.
DOM results are controlled callback values; actual page rendering requires browser/device verification.

results.name: Main-document network and HTTP failures display useful diagnostics
Network, HTTP and TLS subresource errors do not hide a healthy document
Main-document TLS errors are refused and display a certificate diagnostic
Rendered DOM readiness cancels the deadline and preserves the page
HTTP completion with an empty DOM eventually offers recovery
Missing completion hits the bounded loading timeout
Retry succeeds and stale timeouts cannot hide its result
A stale evaluateJavascript reply cannot change a newer load
Late errors from a prior document cannot replace the new page
Initialization failure tolerates retry, back, save, pause and destroy
Destroy cancels scheduled work and ignores outstanding DOM replies
Upgrade rejects saved IP history and restores only the configured origin
Retry and system browser buttons use the configured canonical HTTPS origin
Diagnostic display omits URL query, fragment and user information
A synchronous WebView load failure displays recovery instead of escaping
Complete real Android sources compile against API23 with Java8 bytecode target
